crossRefs.note: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because Yahweh your God gave me success.”
translations.bsb: But Isaac asked his son, “How did you ever find it so quickly, my son?” “Because the LORD your God brought it to me,” he replied.
translations.kjv: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.
translations.asv: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because Jehovah thy God sent me good speed.
